toegepas.voor: Mense het destyds geglo 'n farao leef ná sy dood in die hiernamaals
toegepas.na: Mense het destyds geglo dat 'n farao ná sy dood in die hiernamaals leef
toegepas.rede_vinder: An explicit 'dat' clause is clearer for a Grade 5 reader than the bare reported main clause.
toegepas.fout: The reported clause without 'dat', after a past-tense 'het geglo', reads loosely in written study text and makes the reader pause.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding an explicit 'dat' clause is the standard written form, is clearer for a Grade 5 reader, and leaves the meaning unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'n Stukkie liggaam' is unidiomatic; Afrikaans needs 'van' here.
toegepas.fout: 'n klein stukkie liggaam' treats 'liggaam' as a mass noun, which Afrikaans does not do; the grammar needs 'van 'n'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: This is a plain grammar fix that adds no new meaning and does not touch any of the shared or protected definitions.

laat_vaar.blok: Alles nog waar dit gelaat is
laat_vaar.voor: kon elke ding bestudeer op die plek waar dit gelaat is
laat_vaar.na: kon elke ding op die plek bestudeer waar dit gelaat is
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: In standard Afrikaans the infinitive closes the clause before the relative clause; the adverbial phrase belongs before the verb.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing the heavy phrase after the verb is normal, natural Afrikaans, and the proposal splits 'die plek' from its relative clause, so the change only moves words around without improving anything.

laat_vaar.voor: wys hoe mense elke dag geleef het
laat_vaar.na: wys hoe mense van dag tot dag geleef het
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Elke dag geleef' is a literal rendering of 'everyday life'; 'van dag tot dag' is the idiomatic Afrikaans.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'hoe mense elke dag geleef het' is natural, and 'van dag tot dag' shifts the sense toward getting by from one day to the next, so the meaning moves.

laat_vaar.na: in 'n vak wat Egiptologie genoem word
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Heet' is formal and rare in children's prose; 'genoem word' is the everyday form at this grade.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'heet' is ordinary, natural Afrikaans here, so swapping it for 'genoem word' is a sideways move that also makes the sentence longer.

laat_vaar.voor: Die studie van antieke Egipte, sy mense
laat_vaar.na: Die studie van antieke Egipte: sy mense
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: With a comma, 'antieke Egipte' reads as the first item of the list; a colon shows that the rest spells out what is studied.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The comma list ('Egypt, its people, writings and objects') reads correctly as it stands, and a language agent should not change punctuation in a glossary definition when nothing is wrong.

na_skrywer.na: wiele wat deur perde getrek word
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: As written, 'wat' is the subject, so it literally says the cart pulls horses; the passive removes the misreading.
na_skrywer.fout: In 'wiele wat perde trek', 'wat' can be read as the subject (the cart pulls horses) or attached to 'wiele'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is a real fault, but this is a glossary definition, so the rewording belongs to the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: 'n Siekte met hoë koors wat deur muskiete oorgedra word
na_skrywer.na: 'n Siekte wat deur muskiete oorgedra word en hoë koors veroorsaak
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The relative clause attaches to 'koors', so it says the fever is carried by mosquitoes rather than the disease.
na_skrywer.fout: The relative clause can attach to 'koors', so the definition can be read as saying mosquitoes carry the fever.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The attachment fault is real, but the proposal also changes 'met hoë koors' to 'veroorsaak hoë koors' in a glossary definition, so the writer must fix it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: wat 'n rekenaar saamvoeg om binne-in iets te kyk
na_skrywer.na: wat deur 'n rekenaar saamgevoeg word sodat 'n mens binne-in iets kan kyk
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The active 'wat 'n rekenaar saamvoeg' can be read with the photos as subject, and 'om ... te kyk' has no clear subject; the passive and 'sodat 'n mens' fix both.
na_skrywer.fout: 'om binne-in iets te kyk' has no clear subject, so it reads as if the computer does the looking.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a mild but real fault in a glossary definition, and the proposed passive with 'sodat 'n mens' rewrites it substantially, so it goes to the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: familie en sommige siektes kan wys
na_skrywer.na: familiebande en sommige siektes kan uitwys
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A test shows family relationships, not 'familie' itself; 'uitwys' is the natural verb for what a test reveals.
na_skrywer.fout: 'familie ... kan wys' is vague, because a test reveals relationships, not family as such.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The vagueness is real, but changing 'familie' to 'familiebande' alters what a glossary definition says, so the writer should decide the wording.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
